function.name: search_google
function.description: Performs a search query on Google and returns a list of URLs that match the search criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term to query on Google.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. The number must be a positive integer.

language.description: The language for the search results.

filter.description: A flag to filter explicit content in search results.

date_range.description: The date range for the search results in the format 'MM/DD/YYYY-MM/DD/YYYY'. If not specified, searches across all dates.

message.content:
Here’s a quick snapshot of the most prominent vaccine manufacturers worldwide (as of 2026).  The list includes companies that produce licensed vaccines for COVID‑19, influenza, HPV, meningitis, and other diseases, as well as those that are actively developing next‑generation platforms.

| # | Company | Headquarters | Key Vaccines (licensed & in‑pipeline) | Notable Platforms |
|---|---------|--------------|----------------------------------------|-------------------|
| 1 | **Pfizer‑BioNTech** | New York, USA / Mainz, Germany | BNT162b2 (Comirnaty, COVID‑19), Prevnar 23 (pneumococcal), HPV‑L1 (HPV) | mRNA, protein subunit |
| 2 | **Moderna** | Cambridge, USA | mRNA‑1273 (Spikevax, COVID‑19), mRNA‑1647 (influenza), mRNA‑1345 (HPV) | mRNA |
| 3 | **Johnson & Johnson (Janssen)** | New Brunswick, USA | Ad26.COV2.S (Johnson & Johnson COVID‑19), Ad26.ZEBOV (Ebola), Ad26.COV2.S‑RBD (COVID‑19 booster) | Adenovirus‑vectored |
| 4 | **Novavax** | Gaithersburg, USA | NVX-CoV2373 (Nuvaxovid, COVID‑19), NVX‑Flu (influenza) | Recombinant protein + Matrix-M adjuvant |
| 5 | **AstraZeneca** | Cambridge, UK | ChAdOx1 nCoV‑19 (AZD1222, COVID‑19), Cervarix (HPV), Vaxzevria (COVID‑19) | Adenovirus‑vectored |
| 6 | **Sanofi Pasteur** | Paris, France | Fluzone (influenza), Menveo (meningococcal), Prevnar 13 (pneumococcal) | Inactivated, conjugate |
| 7 | **GlaxoSmithKline (GSK)** | Brentford, UK | Engerix‑B (HBV), Shingrix (shingles), Fluzone (influenza) | Inactivated, subunit, adjuvanted |
| 8 | **Merck & Co. (MSD)** | Kenilworth, USA | Gardasil 9 (HPV), RotaTeq (rotavirus), MMR (measles‑mumps‑rubella) | Live‑attenuated, subunit |
| 9 | **Bharat Biotech** | Hyderabad, India | Covaxin (BBV152, COVID‑19), Bexsero (meningitis B) | Inactivated, subunit |
|10 | **Sinovac Biotech** | Beijing, China | CoronaVac (COVID‑19), Influenza A/B | Inactivated |
|11 | **Sinopharm (Hepatitis B, COVID‑19)** | Beijing, China | BBIBP‑CorV (COVID‑19), HBV | Inactivated |
|12 | **CureVac** | Tübingen, Germany | CVnCoV (COVID‑19, clinical phase 3), CVnCoV‑2 (influenza) | Non‑replicating mRNA |
|13 | **GSK‑Pfizer (Co‑development)** | – | – | mRNA‑based influenza & RSV candidates |
|14 | **Biontech (German subsidiary of Pfizer)** | – | – | – |
|15 | **Serum Institute of India** | Pune, India | Covishield (ChAdOx1‑nCoV‑19), various influenza & hepatitis vaccines | Adenovirus‑vectored, inactivated |

### How to Use This List
- **Research**: If you’re looking into specific vaccine technologies, focus on the “Notable Platforms” column.
- **Regulatory**: For licensing status, check the FDA, EMA, or WHO pre‑qualification lists.
- **Supply Chain**: Major manufacturers often have regional production sites; contact their corporate sites for detailed capacity info.

Let me know if you’d like deeper details on any company, their pipeline, or recent clinical trial outcomes!
